name: Explore district and ADM3 boundary layers
description: Verifies the geographic explorer loads the sourced Sierra Leone administrative polygons and identifies dataset provenance.
steps: Open the Geographic Explorer section
Wait for the district and ADM3 layers to load
Review layer controls and source attribution
expected: The interactive map displays the available legacy Sierra Leone district and ADM3 reference polygons, with layer toggles, source years and attribution visible; the directory separately identifies 18 gazetted district names and warns that post-2026 boundary and electoral crosswalk validation is pending.

name: Find and display Koya and East III
description: Verifies Koya and East III are selectable geographic features and highlighted from the source ADM3 layer without geometry edits.
steps: Search for Koya and select it under ADM3 areas
Confirm the Koya feature is highlighted
Search for East III and select it under ADM3 areas
expected: Koya and East III can both be selected and highlighted as ADM3 source features; their geometries are displayed unchanged.

name: Use the map on a mobile screen
description: Verifies map controls and source limitations remain readable on a narrow viewport.
steps: Open a constituency detail page on a mobile viewport
Use the map focus selector to choose East III
Review the geography note below the map
expected: The map controls stack vertically, East III can be selected, and the page states that ADM3 reference geometry is not a constituency boundary.

name: Automatically focus the parent district when opening a constituency
description: Verifies opening a constituency automatically frames its parent district in the enlarged map and preserves the administrative context without inventing constituency geometry.
steps: Open a district dashboard and choose one of its constituency entries
Scroll to the geography section
Review the map extent, selected district highlight and ADM3 overlay
expected: The map automatically zooms to fit the complete parent district within the enlarged map canvas, highlights the district, keeps ADM3 reference areas visible and labels the selected constituency without implying that a constituency boundary is available.

name: Keep RRF ward selection locked until constituency assignments are complete
covers: preservation of original ECSL ward identifiers
description: Verifies the imported 446-record ECSL ward source register and reconciliation findings are visible while RRF ward selection and sequential numbering remain locked until verified constituency assignments exist.
steps: Open the Ward Register from the top navigation
At the 375px mobile viewport, select Kenema from the district tiles and confirm the records list is filtered
Search for ward number 030 and review the source record and warning
Select Bandajuma and confirm no ward records are fabricated
Filter the register to Kailahun and locate Ward 030
Review the Ward 030 warning, source description and 446-versus-442 district summary discrepancy
Open RRF Capture and select a district and constituency
Open the Ward selector
expected: The Ward Register shows 446 unique source records with descriptions and provenance, preserves Ward 030 under the published Kailahun heading with a review warning, explains the district summary discrepancy, and reports all constituency assignments pending. In RRF Capture, the Ward selector remains disabled and no synthetic or sequential ward values are offered. The mobile layout keeps the district directory and search controls usable without horizontal overflow; selecting Kenema and searching 030 filters the records, while Bandajuma shows no assigned source wards.
